io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: OAuth 2.1. Clients register themselves (RFC 7591 dynamic client registration) and authorize with PKCE S256 — no token to paste and no key to issue by hand. Discovery is the standard one: an unauthenticated call to /mcp returns 401 with a WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata pointer to https://thepantrybutler.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Scopes are read and write; write implies read. Long-lived bearer tokens from https://thepantrybutler.com/connect still work for scripts and self-hosted clients.
